meta.description: Context token budget for agents. Each doc earns its place.
meta.budget_explanation: Kimi has 256K context. We reserve 8K for project config so 248K remains for actual work.

optional_docs.note: Load ONLY when working on that specific domain.

optimization_rules: If context > 200K, summarize old conversation before continuing
If maps are stale (>1h), regenerate before reading
Never load OMEGA_UI_SWARM_PROMPT.md unless doing UI work
Never load CRITIQUE_AND_PLAN.md unless doing planning
Load only 1 optional doc per session
CODEMAP.json can be queried with jq — don't load entire file
Use SKILLMAP.json to find 1 skill, then load only that skill
